t: Panama seceded from Colombia in 1903 with American backing so that the United States could build a canal across the isthmus.
The United States controlled the Canal Zone for most of the century, and military rulers governed Panama from 1968 to 1989.
Under the Torrijos–Carter Treaties Panama took full control of the canal on 31 December 1999.
dyk: The 1903 treaty granting the United States the Canal Zone was signed for Panama by a Frenchman, Philippe Bunau-Varilla, before the Panamanian delegation had reached Washington.
ev: Panama declares independence from Colombia and signs the Hay–Bunau-Varilla Treaty
The Panama Canal opens on 15 August
Flag riots in the Canal Zone leave more than 20 Panamanians dead
The National Guard overthrows Arnulfo Arias, beginning military rule
Omar Torrijos and Jimmy Carter sign the canal treaties
The United States invades and removes Manuel Noriega
Panama takes full control of the canal on 31 December
The expanded canal with larger locks opens
